description: Source code for utility functions related to mTLS (Mutual TLS) certificate management, including initialization, cleanup, and certificate retrieval, with conditional compilation for different build environments.

methods.name: initMtls
methods.description: Initializes mTLS by preparing certificates, possibly fetching config files, and setting up environment based on device properties.

methods.name: uninitMtls
methods.description: Cleans up mTLS setup by removing temporary certificate files.

methods.name: get_system_uptime
methods.description: Reads and returns the system uptime from /proc/uptime.

methods.name: getMtlsCerts
methods.description: Retrieves mTLS certificates and passphrases, either from environment variables or from static files, depending on build configuration.
